0022600149.text: The Pelicans host the Atlanta Hawks in New Orleans's sixth game of the season, with the Pelicans at 1-4 (1-2 at home, on a W1 streak) and 14th in the West, 4 games back in the Southwest. Atlanta is 3-3 (1-2 on the road, no, 2-1 on the road, on a W1 streak), 2nd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back. New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans lost both games of the 2025-26 season series, most recently 117-100 in Atlanta on January 7.
